name: codex-desktop
description: Navigate live Codex Desktop projects and tasks from Logitech MX Keypad

scripts.build: npm run build:typescript && npm run build:adapter
scripts.build:pack: npm run build:prod && npm run pack
scripts.build:prod: npm run typecheck && cross-env NODE_ENV=production tsup && npm run build:adapter
scripts.test: npm run test:typescript && npm run test:adapter
scripts.test:adapter: dotnet run --disable-build-servers --project adapter/CodexKeypad.ContractTests/CodexKeypad.ContractTests.csproj && dotnet build --disable-build-servers -m:1 -nodeReuse:false -p:UseSharedCompilation=false adapter/CodexKeypad.AdapterTests/CodexKeypad.AdapterTests.csproj && dotnet run --disable-build-servers --no-build --project adapter/CodexKeypad.AdapterTests/CodexKeypad.AdapterTests.csproj
